scope: Primary academic works and official provider documentation. Selected sections/indexed excerpts only; no systematic review, independent proof verification or financial validation.

sources.title: Intraday periodicity and volatility persistence in financial markets
sources.review_depth: Indexed author-PDF abstract/introduction and selected periodicity excerpt; institutional abstract opened. Direct PDF text extraction returned zero lines; screenshot tool returned only text placeholders, so no visual/full-body reading claimed.
sources.supports: Intraday periodicity matters for high-frequency return dynamics; motivates session/slot controls.
sources.does_not_support: Project RVOL threshold3, robust z4, 20-session sample sufficiency, contemporary BIST or crypto performance. Volume profile in experiment is constructed.

sources.title: Controlling the False Discovery Rate: A Practical and Powerful Approach to Multiple Testing
sources.review_depth: Publisher metadata and summary read. Independence/FDR interpretation checked; original full proof not read. Algorithm statement also inspected in original MS-03 section1.2.
sources.supports: FDR is an expected false fraction; independent-test BH method.
sources.does_not_support: Financial robust scores are valid p-values; repeated per-window filtering controls a user's full-day alert probability.

sources.title: The control of the false discovery rate in multiple testing under dependency
sources.review_depth: Author-upload attribution checked; original paper sections1.2–1.4, FDR definition, Theorems1.2/1.3 and selected one-sided/two-sided dependence cautions read. Full proof not independently verified. Euclid direct page produced iframe-only content; author draft text extraction garbled; readable original author-upload used as fallback.
sources.supports: BH requires appropriate dependence conditions; harmonic BY modification gives conservative control with valid null p-values under arbitrary dependence; two-sided dependence requires care.
sources.does_not_support: Repairing invalid tail probabilities, uncertainty in provenance, finance-market calibration or online/time-uniform control.

sources.title: Conformal prediction beyond exchangeability
sources.review_depth: Abstract, introduction, split-conformal section2 and selected section4.3 remarks on weights/drift checked. No proof replication or finance experiment performed.
sources.supports: Ordinary conformal inference requires exchangeability/symmetry; drift changes guarantees; training and calibration separation matters.
sources.does_not_support: Automatic valid financial anomaly p-values using20 observations, or that proposed weighted methods are deployed here.

sources.title: Event Studies in Economics and Finance
sources.review_depth: Indexed original-paper excerpt on page15 read: market model stable linear relation; estimation normally prior to event and excluding event. PDF extraction largely linked references, so no full-body reading claimed. Filename says1996 and upload path2011; neither used as publication year.
sources.supports: Separating normal market relation from asset abnormal return and fitting before the event.
sources.does_not_support: Beta-one is universally valid, OLS is robust to beta drift, residual removes causality or z4 is empirically validated.

sources.title: Alpaca Historical bars API reference
sources.review_depth: Endpoint parameters read: feed IEX/SIP/BOATS/OTC, raw/split/dividend/spin-off adjustments, asof symbol mapping and pagination. No authenticated request or account/entitlement check.
sources.supports: Feed coverage and price/volume adjustment are explicit dimensions; default symbol asof is current date.
sources.does_not_support: Specific rights, available real feed subscription, a5x IEX/SIP volume ratio or point-in-time revision-free corporate action archive.
